messages:
anne (support): Customer opened a ticket: our /v1/rerank returns 400 when invoked through their Java proxy. They say request mirrors SDK example but fails.

anne (support): Payload they sent (they claimed 'envelope' wrapping on their side):

anne (support): Curl they provided:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \ 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
  -d '{"items":"[{\"id\":\"a1\",\"text\":\"foo\"}]","top_k":1}'
```

anne (support): Server response: 400 {"error":"request.items must be an array"} 

tim (eng): Looks like their proxy/stringifier is turning the items array into a JSON string (see quotes around items). Can you attach the raw edge request bytes? :eyes: 

anne (support): Edge request log snippet (LB):
```
POST /v1/rerank HTTP/1.1
Content-Type: application/json
Authorization: Bearer REDACTED
Content-Length: 72

{"items":"[{\"id\":\"a1\",\"text\":\"foo\"}]","top_k":1}
```

juan (eng-sre): Confirms — items is a string. Common culprits: (1) client calling Gson.toJson(items) then embedding result into envelope, (2) proxy/form encoding that serializes JSON into a string field, (3) incorrect Content-Type/charset interactions.

tim (eng): Quick repro plan: 
1) Send proper array -> expect 200.
2) Send stringified array -> expect 400.

Good body example:
```
{"items":[{"id":"a1","text":"foo"}],"top_k":1}
```

anne (support): Customer found the issue: their okhttp interceptor was calling gson.toJson(items) and then putting that string into the envelope map. They patched it to pass the native list.

juan (eng-sre): Proposed mitigation: (A) improve error text to hint at stringified arrays, (B) add tolerant parsing behind a feature flag to accept string vs array for a short period. Filed INF-8492.

tim (eng): I created INF-8492 and added an infra alert to detect spikes of 400s with the same request shape/source IP. Also scheduled a small docs note for Java proxy examples.

anne (support): Customer retested after removing the extra toJson() -> now 200 :thumbsup: 

api-bot: Deploy 2026-03-17T15:05:00Z: rolled nginx edge logging tweak to capture redacted parsed bodies on 400 responses.

juan (eng-sre): Follow-up: PR incoming to docs with Java+okhttp anti-pattern snippet and recommended envelope patterns.

anne (support): Marking support ticket RESOLVED after customer confirmation. Adding final notes to ticket for future reference.
